heading.text: Sealed Orders (working title) — capital ship duel mockup

howto.text: Press Play on the battle board. Click inside the blue zone to plot Resolute's course and pick an order, then Commit — or double-click to plot and commit in one go. Both ships move at once; in gunnery you roll your own dice in the dice tray. Click a ship (or Next ship) to inspect it; hover a damage tag to see the rolls. Tweaks panel: hot-seat.
